content:
We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the forward reaction described: carbonyl-ene reaction intramolecular forming 5-membered ring, converting C=C and C=O to C-C and C-O, forming aliphatic hydroxyl and five-membered ring. So retrosynthetic step: break the new C-C bond and C-O bond to get precursor with alkene and carbonyl separate.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken: "C-C double bonds", "ketones"? Actually forward reaction forms C-C bond and C-O bond, breaks C=C and C=O. So broken groups: "C-C double bonds", "ketones". Formed groups: "aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings". Also bond changes: C=C to C-C (order changed) and C=O to C-O (order changed). So we can search.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with those criteria and limit maybe 5.
